Date Sheet – Spring 2026
“Creation” window opens 14 days prior to exam start.
Exam start date: 15-02-2026

Rescheduling of missed papers: 4 to 7 days after normal exams end, i.e. 05/03/2026.
Results announced approximately 12–16 days after exams end.
